t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup. A warm limestone top strip with a small eyebrow and a large light-weight sans headline. Below, a full-width deep navy band holding one large isometric line drawing of a polypropylene water skid in white and pale steel-blue hairlines, no shading. Along the base of the band, a row of numbered short notes for <CONTENT> with steel-blue numerals. A limestone closing strip carries one large light sans line as the outcome. Square corners, flat, calm and technical.
signature_idea: One navy band shows the whole skid as a blueprint while the visit's checks line up along its base, closed by a single signed-report line.
strengths: band-and-sheet rhythm is clear and on-brand
white line drawing on navy is the brand's blueprint language
closing outcome line on limestone is a strong, simple ending
light headline and steel-blue numerals fit the type system
weaknesses: checks 01 and 04 are duplicated at the top of the band
check labels do not point to any part of the drawing
skid shows UV, EDI, softener tank and a metal-looking cabinet, drifting off-offer
bottom notes crowd into the drawing and overlap it
the notch connecting band and closing strip is unexplained
brand_fit_why: Navy band, limestone strips, white blueprint linework, light headline and steel-blue numerals fit closely, but duplicated notes and unlinked labels weaken it.
